answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond in a shared vault before trading. It returns only after a long history of verified, useful work, so a sybil farmer must fund thousands of bonds at once and wait months to recover them. Like timber seasoning before it can bear weight, reputation must age: new accounts start with tiny transaction limits that grow only as completed jobs accumulate. Faking that history is as costly as carving ivory by hand - each fake job still burns real compute, real counterparties, and real time.
